# CALL Electric LLC

> Licensed electrical contractor in Lewisburg, WV, serving Greenbrier County and surrounding areas. Owned by master electrician Chris Ratliff — Generac Certified Service Technician offering residential and commercial electrical services.

CALL Electric specializes in panel mapping, electrical upgrades, surge/lightning/EMP protection, backup generator installation, whole-house wiring, and Generac generator service. Contact: (304) 578-5918 or chris@callelectric.net.

- [Home](https://www.callelectric.net/): Main landing page with services overview, testimonials, and quote request

## Services

- [Panel Mapping](https://www.callelectric.net/service/panel-mapping): Circuit IQ smart panel mapping and breaker labeling
- [Electrical Upgrades](https://www.callelectric.net/service/electrical-upgrades): Panel, breaker, lighting, and service equipment upgrades
- [Surge, Lightning, and EMP Protection](https://www.callelectric.net/service/protection): Surge protectors, lightning, and EMP shielding
- [Backup Generator Installation](https://www.callelectric.net/service/generator-installs): Generac backup generators, inlet boxes, and interlock kits
